title: Indian-Style Oven Biryani
description: A flavorful and aromatic Indian-inspired rice dish cooked in the oven with marinated chicken. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Marinate the chicken in a mixture of yogurt, garam masala, cumin, turmeric, red chili powder, and salt for at least 30 minutes.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the marinated chicken and cook until browned on both sides, about 5-7 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked rice, chopped cilantro, and salt. Mix well.

In a 9x13 inch baking dish, create a layer of rice mixture. Top with a layer of chicken, then another layer of rice mixture. Repeat this process until all ingredients are used, ending with a layer of rice on top.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the foil and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the top layer is lightly browned.
Let the dish rest for 5 minutes before serving.
